params.caption: 🎮 Skydance Games cuts jobs after the Paramount–Warner Bros. merger Skydance Games has confirmed layoffs, roughly a month after Paramount's acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery brought the companies' game teams together. The studio says it is scaling down some of its projects as the merged division reorganises. 🕒 Nov 10, 2026 · 00:36 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: IGN #Skydance #Layoffs #GamingNews
